tickets.title: Prepare life insurance coverage analysis
tickets.text: Prepare life insurance coverage analysis reflecting Nora's adoption, Derek's reduced household income during leave, the mortgage balance, and current group and term policies.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare life insurance coverage analysis by 2026-03-09 reflecting Nora’s adoption, Derek’s reduced household income during leave, the mortgage balance, and current group and term policies.

tickets.title: Create one view of childcare and education funding tradeoffs
tickets.text: Create one view of childcare and education funding tradeoffs showing reserve impact, dependent-care reimbursements, and possible education account funding levels.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2026-03-12 to create one view of childcare and education funding tradeoffs because the daycare quote and desired college savings contribution would draw from the same monthly surplus, showing reserve impact, dependent-care reimbursements, and possible education account funding levels.

tickets.title: Address dependent-care enrollment timing
tickets.text: Address dependent-care enrollment timing because Derek's employer portal shows a benefits enrollment window closing soon, and Alina was unsure which parent's dependent-care arrangement should be used given the expected daycare start and leave transition.
